rule: Red when two or more of its metrics are red, or one is red and two others amber; amber when one is red or two or more are amber; green otherwise. Metrics with no data are left out.
Red when two or more perspectives are red, or one is red and another amber; amber when one is red or two or more are amber; green otherwise.
Per perspective: red when a quarter or more of the book is red; amber when red and amber together pass 40%; green otherwise.
